title: File:Structural changes in the putamen and pallidum in patients with long COVID fatigue.jpg
art:
Authors of the study:

   Josephine Heine
   Katia Schwichtenberg
   Tim J. Hartung
   Sophia Rekers
   Claudia Chien
desc: "Structural changes in the putamen (A) and pallidum (B) in patients with post-COVID fatigue. Marked surface deformations, volume loss, and aberrant diffusion parameters show involvement of the basal ganglia in long-term fatigue after COVID-19 (boxplots with whiskers extending to 1.5∗IQR)."

title: File:Structural thalamic changes in patients with post-COVID fatigue.jpg
art:
Authors of the study:

   Josephine Heine
   Katia Schwichtenberg
   Tim J. Hartung
   Sophia Rekers
   Claudia Chien
desc: "Structural thalamic changes in patients with post-COVID fatigue. Patients with moderate or severe fatigue after COVID-19 showed significantly higher thalamic fractional anisotropy (FA) and surface deformations (boxplots with whiskers extending to 1.5∗IQR)."
